answer_1.quote: This paper seeks to evaluate the trustworthiness of children's stories generated by LLMs including generative LLMs and instruction following models.

answer_2.quote: we use various metrics to compare the generated stories with actual stories, including in-text statistics such as sentence length and a measure of toxicity in the text, as well as an evaluation of topics covered in these stories.
automatic_metrics: sentence structure (dependency tree and Weisfeiler Lehman hash)
